name: Studia
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Turn one idea into several designs, organise them on a canvas without leaving ChatGPT, and refine them by marking what to change.

For branding, art direction and graphic design: generate illustrations, logos, posters, flyers, packaging, ads, social posts, product shots, photo shoots, interiors and moodboards.

Mark the part of an image you want changed, or mark parts of several images to combine them. Then say or type what you want.

Ask for directions from your latest brainstorm or a client email thread. ChatGPT can draw on its memory of your chats and your connected apps, and Studia turns those references, briefs and ideas into boards of images.

What you can do
- Generate multiple images: ask for several directions or variations in one go. Each arrives as its own image, side by side, so you can compare them and pick what to take further.
- Organise on a canvas: move, group and arrange images on a board instead of losing them in a scrolling chat.
- Moodboards that make new images: collect references from the web or your own pictures on a board, then use them to guide what gets made next.
- Edit by pointing: mark parts of one or several images, say what should change or which parts to combine, and the new version lands next to the old one.
- Talk and mark together: hold S and brain-dump out loud while you mark the canvas. Studia turns both into images.
- Choose your image model: switch between the latest image generation models to get the look you want.
- Reuse images and boards across chats: boards and references are saved to your account, so any chat can open them and build on earlier work.

Who it is for
Designers, art directors, founders, marketers, and anyone with a visual idea they want to explore by talking and sketching.

Try prompts like
- @Studia, make 3 logo ideas for my coffee brand.
- @Studia, turn this product photo into 4 ad images for Instagram.
- @Studia, design packaging for my tea in three directions.
- @Studia, show my living room in three different moods.
- @Studia, find café interior references on the web and make a moodboard for my new shop.
- @Studia, read my last client call transcript and turn their ideas into 3 directions.
- @Studia, add these references to my board and use their colors.
- @Studia, take the colors from this image and the layout from that one.

Voice works in ChatGPT on the web.
